identity.caution: The Kaikarmet Yandex gallery and panorama show Sultan signage; 2GIS uses Sultan for the corresponding market area. This supports the geographic market composition, not legal equivalence, ownership or a claim that every neighbouring building belongs to Kaikarmet. Frontend slug remains kaikarmet.

strongest_visual_findings: The street frontage is a long continuous low blue-glazed hall with dense cobalt vertical mullions and a broad cream/light grey fascia. The old two detached pale halls are not supported.
The main entrance is a broad rectangular recess interrupting that glazed frontage, with blue jambs and glazed doors further back. No monumental main-front arch is visible.
The 2023 panorama shows two adjacent low projecting corrugated lean-to canopies immediately to the left of the main entrance, with slender posts and counters.
Market-aisle photographs show a much larger shared corrugated steel roof above independent low kiosks, with steel posts and exposed braces/trusses.

A separate cream masonry gateway has a very shallow angular pointed opening, classical columns/cornice/dentils, reddish base and turquoise metal bar gates. Its exact position in a complete surveyed site plan is not established.

Satellite view suggests a compact elongated connected compound with parallel roof strips: street gallery, broad raised central roof and lower rear strip. The central roof appears curved and interrupted across its length; exact roof curvature and connections remain an interpretation.

observations: Long blue-glazed facade and broad pale fascia
Large recessed rectangular entrance right of the viewed frontage centre
Two adjacent low sheet-metal canopies immediately left of entrance
Small white kiosk on entrance left and red kiosk on right
Cars parked perpendicular to street frontage
references.limits: Winter panorama; not proof of unchanged 2026 condition. Perspective prevents exact metric measurements.

model_decisions.dimensions_note: All numbers are illustrative proportions chosen to model the observed composition. No photogrammetry, cadastral outline, survey or calibrated measurement was performed.
implemented_changes: Replace two pale detached halls with long continuous blue glass frontage
Add broad cream fascia, narrow blue bands and repeated mullions
Make a recessed rectangular main entrance
Add two low adjacent lean-to street canopies
Add independent low kiosks under a broad shared raised roof
Arrange rear/central/front strips as a connected compound
Add observed shallow pointed cream side gate with turquoise bars
Use four anonymous parked cars as scale cues
Keep all lettering as frontend HTML; no invented real stall numbers
unverified_and_simplified: Exact whole-site positioning of side gateway
Roof curvature, transverse seam and all strip lengths
Unseen shop layout, bay counts and structural spacing
All hotspot positions and associations remain educational zones
